component.name: NEOPOSE
component.summary: 3D figure for drawing: poses, anatomy, clothes and sets
Figura 3D para dibujar: poses, anatomía, ropa y escenarios

description.p: NEOPOSE is a 3D mannequin for artists. Pose one or more characters, dress them, place them in a lit set and use the result as a drawing reference.
NEOPOSE es un maniquí 3D para artistas. Posa a uno o varios personajes, vístelos, colócalos en un escenario iluminado y usa el resultado como referencia de dibujo.

ul.li: Pose with IK (drag hands, feet and hips), FK (drag any joint and only its bone turns) or by rotating each joint; pin hands and feet, blend poses, sit on furniture; almost 100 poses for one to four characters

Posado con IK (arrastra manos, pies y pelvis), FK (arrastra cualquier articulación y solo gira su hueso) o girando cada articulación; clava manos y pies, mezcla poses, siéntate en muebles; casi 100 poses de uno a cuatro personajes
Human anatomy from MakeHuman: from childhood to old age, gender, muscle, weight, height and stylisation, from realistic to chibi; hairstyles, facial expressions and a real skeleton view
Anatomía humana de MakeHuman: de la infancia a la vejez, género, músculo, peso, altura y estilización, de realista a chibi; peinados, expresiones faciales y vista del esqueleto real
Anthro characters: wolf, fox, dog, cat, rabbit, goat and dragon with sculpted heads (realistic, toony and kemono), digitigrade or hoofed legs, claws and tails
Personajes anthro: lobo, zorro, perro, gato, conejo, cabra y dragón con cabezas esculpidas (realistas, toony y kemono), patas digitígradas o con pezuña, garras y cola
Import your own humanoid avatars (VRM, GLB, FBX) or pick a free one from the Open Source Avatars gallery, and pose them with the same tools
Importa tus avatares humanoides (VRM, GLB, FBX) o elige uno libre de la galería de Open Source Avatars, y pósalos con las mismas herramientas
469 garments that fit any body and pose
469 prendas que se adaptan a cualquier cuerpo y pose
24 sets with their own lamps and shadows (living room, tavern, castle, theatre, street, forest, beach…) and 8 360° panoramas
24 escenarios con lámparas y sombras propias (salón, taberna, castillo, teatro, calle, bosque, playa…) y 8 panoramas de 360°
Drawing finishes (construction, volume, pencil, values, silhouette), guides and a sketch layer
Acabados de dibujo (construcción, volumen, lápiz, valores, silueta), guías y capa de boceto
Gesture practice with a timer; pose from a photo, offline; animation timeline
Export: PNG up to A3 at 300 ppi, turnaround sheets, AI maps (depth, normals, OpenPose), GLB, BVH, MP4/WebM video, animated GIF and frames by layer
Práctica de gesto con temporizador; pose desde una foto, sin conexión; línea de tiempo de animación
Exportación: PNG hasta A3 a 300 ppp, hojas de giro, mapas para IA (profundidad, normales, OpenPose), GLB, BVH, vídeo MP4/WebM, GIF animado y fotogramas por capas
Animation principles on any move: easing, anticipation, bounce, drag, arcs, squash and stretch, exaggeration and timing, with spacing trails
Principios de animación en cualquier movimiento: suavidad, anticipación, rebote, arrastre, arcos, estirar y encoger, exageración y ritmo, con trayectorias
Layered PSD and an “Open in…” button that opens it straight in Krita, GIMP, Clip Studio Paint, Photoshop…
PSD con capas y botón «Abrir en…» que lo abre directamente en Krita, GIMP, Clip Studio Paint, Photoshop…
Save whole characters (body, clothes, prostheses) and reuse them; poses and animations with crutches, walking aids and wheelchairs
From script to film: a written scene becomes an animated film with voices, subtitles and film-grammar camera shots
Del guion a la película: una escena escrita se convierte en una película animada con voces, subtítulos y planos con reglas de cine
Free reference search (photos, GIFs, panoramas) turned into poses, animations and sets
Buscador de referencias libres (fotos, GIF, panoramas) para poses, animaciones y escenarios
Guarda personajes completos (cuerpo, ropa, prótesis) y reutilízalos; poses y animaciones con muletas, ayudas para caminar y silla de ruedas

description.p: From script to film: write a scene as a script and NEOPOSE animates it, with no AI: cast, set and time of day, actions read from plain sentences in seven languages, on-device voices with lip sync, subtitles and camera shots chosen by film grammar.
Free references: search openly licensed photos, GIFs and panoramas and turn them into poses, animations and sets, with the light from the panorama's sun and a content filter on the device.

Animation principles (easing, anticipation, bounce, drag, arcs, squash and stretch), dynamism tools for still pictures, layered PSD and an "Open in…" button for drawing programs, GIF and MP4 export, saved characters, and poses and animations with crutches and wheelchairs.
Drag poses, clothes, colours and objects onto the canvas with a live preview, Ctrl+K search, finger gestures, context menus, and an installable web app for iPhone and iPad.
Films made of shots, with camera moves and a script whose lines move the mouths, an animation gallery (96 moves, BVH, GLB and FBX import) and storyboards, photos or video turned into animation.
Muscles that react to the pose, skin that keeps its volume, body builds and advanced body settings, and limb differences with posable prostheses; wheelchair, crutches and walking frame.
Hair, old age, facial expressions, a real skeleton view, pinned hands and feet, pose blending, 360° panoramas, perspective framings, pose from a photo and shareable scene links.
Gesture practice can dress characters (a random outfit or random garments) and put an object in their hand that never clips through anyone or anything.
The katana, bat and axe are now held by the handle.
English is now the default language; Spanish can be chosen in Help.
Gesture practice can change the body on every pose (optionally including anthro characters and chibis) and the set.
